data.name: UN001Title
data.value: Extract complex condition into a named variable

data.name: UN001MessageFormat
data.value: Condition has {0} operands; assign it to a variable whose name explains the intent

data.name: UN001Description
data.value: Long or multi-line boolean conditions hide the intent of a branch. Assign the condition to a local variable whose name states what it means.

data.name: UN002MessageFormat
data.value: Remove this ThrowIfCancellationRequested call; pass the cancellation token to the cancellable operations instead

data.name: UN002Description
data.value: Cancellable operations already observe the token they are given. Calling ThrowIfCancellationRequested outside a loop adds noise without making the code more responsive to cancellation.

data.name: UN003Title
data.value: Try statement should wrap an entire method body

data.name: UN003MessageFormat
data.value: Move this try statement into its own method so it is the whole method body

data.name: UN003Description
data.value: A try statement in the middle of a block tangles one operation's error handling with the surrounding flow. Extract the guarded operation into its own method whose body is the try statement.
